verses.text: Paul and Timothy, the servants of Jesus Christ. To all the saints (holy people) in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the bishops (church leaders) and deacons:
Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
I thank my God on every remembrance of you.
In every prayer of mine for you all, I always make request with joy.
I thank God for your fellowship (sharing) in the gospel (good news) from the first day until now.
I am confident of this very thing. God has begun a good work in you. God will perform (keep doing) it until the day of Jesus Christ.

It is meet (right) for me to think this of you all. I have you in my heart. You all are partakers (sharers) of my grace. This is true in my bonds (chains). It is true in the defence and confirmation (proving) of the gospel (good news).
God is my record (witness) of how greatly I long after you all. I long for you in the bowels (deep love) of Jesus Christ.
And this I pray: that your love may abound (grow) yet more and more, in knowledge and in all judgment (understanding).
Then you may approve things that are excellent. Then you may be sincere (pure) and without offence (fault) till the day of Christ.
You will be filled with the fruits of righteousness (being right with God), which are by Jesus Christ. This is to the glory and praise of God.
But I want you to understand this, brothers. Things have happened to me. They have fallen out (turned out) rather to the furtherance (spreading) of the gospel (good news).
My bonds (chains) in Christ are manifest (plain to see) in all the palace, and in all other places.
And many of the brothers in the Lord are waxing confident (growing bold) by my bonds (chains). They are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife (quarrels). And some also preach Christ of good will.
The one side preaches Christ of contention (fighting), not sincerely (with an honest heart). They suppose they add affliction (trouble) to my bonds (chains).
But the other side preaches of love. They know that I am set for the defence of the gospel (good news).
What then? Notwithstanding (even so), Christ is preached every way, whether in pretence (pretending) or in truth. And I do rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
For I know that this will turn to my salvation through your prayer. It will also turn so through the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.

This is according to my earnest expectation and my hope. In nothing will I be ashamed. With all boldness, as always, so now also Christ will be magnified (honored) in my body. This will be so whether it be by life, or by death.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
But if I live in the flesh (body), this is the fruit of my labour (work). Yet I do not know what I will choose.
For I am in a strait (pulled) between 2. I have a desire to depart, and to be with Christ, which is far better.
Nevertheless to abide (stay) in the flesh (body) is more needful for you.
And I have this confidence. I know that I will abide (stay) and continue with you all. This is for your furtherance (growth) and joy of faith.
Then your rejoicing in Jesus Christ may be more abundant for me. This will be by my coming to you again.

Only let your conversation (way of life) be as it becomes (is right for) the gospel (good news) of Christ. Whether I come and see you, or else am absent, I may hear of your affairs. I want to hear that you stand fast in one spirit. I want to hear that you strive together with one mind. You strive for the faith of the gospel (good news).
And be in nothing terrified by your adversaries (enemies). This is to them an evident token (clear sign) of perdition (destruction). But to you it is a sign of salvation, and that of God.
It is given to you in the behalf of Christ. You are not only to believe on Him. You are also to suffer for His sake.
You have the same conflict (struggle) which you saw in me. You now hear it is still in me.

verses.text: If there is therefore any consolation (comfort) in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship (sharing) of the Spirit, if any bowels (deep love) and mercies,
Then fulfil my joy, that you be likeminded (think the same way). Have the same love, being of one accord (agreement), of one mind.
Let nothing be done through strife (quarrels) or vainglory (empty pride). But in lowliness (humbleness) of mind let each esteem (think of) others better than themselves.
Do not look every one on their own things. But every one also look on the things of others.
Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus.
Christ, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery (taking what was not His) to be equal with God.
But Christ made Himself of no reputation (nothing important). He took upon Him the form of a servant. He was made in the likeness (looking like) of men.
And being found in fashion (appearance) as a man, He humbled Himself. He became obedient to death, even the death of the cross.
Therefore God also has highly exalted (lifted up) Jesus. God has given Him a name which is above every name.
So at the name of Jesus every knee should bow. Every knee in heaven, and in earth, and under the earth should bow.
And every tongue should confess (say openly) that Jesus Christ is Lord. This is to the glory of God the Father.
Therefore, my beloved (dearly loved), you have always obeyed. You obeyed not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence. Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
For it is God who works in you. God works in you both to will and to do of His good pleasure.
Do all things without murmurings (complaining) and disputings (arguing).
Then you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke (fault). You live in the middle of a crooked and perverse (twisted) nation. Among them you shine as lights in the world.
Hold forth the word of life. Then I may rejoice in the day of Christ. I will know I have not run in vain (for nothing). I have not laboured (worked hard) in vain (for nothing).
Yes, and if I am offered (poured out) on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy. And I rejoice with you all.
For the same cause also you joy, and rejoice with me.
But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly to you. Then I also may be of good comfort (take heart), when I know your state.
For I have no one likeminded (thinking the same way), who will naturally care for your state.
For all seek their own things. They do not seek the things which are Jesus Christ's.
But you know the proof of Timothy. As a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel (good news).
So I hope to send Timothy presently (right away). I will send him as soon as I see how it will go with me.
But I trust in the Lord that I also myself will come shortly.

Yet I supposed it necessary to send Epaphroditus to you. Epaphroditus is my brother, and companion in labour (work), and fellowsoldier. He is your messenger, and he ministered (served) to my wants (needs).
For Epaphroditus longed after you all, and was full of heaviness (very troubled). This was because you had heard that he had been sick.
For indeed he was sick near to death. But God had mercy on him. God had mercy not on him only, but on me also. Then I would not have sorrow upon sorrow.
So I sent him the more carefully (eagerly). When you see him again, you may rejoice. And I may be the less sorrowful (sad).
Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness (joy). Hold such people in reputation (honor).
For the work of Christ Epaphroditus was near to death, not regarding (caring about) his life. He did this to supply your lack of service toward me.

verses.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you is not grievous (hard) to me. For you it is safe.
Beware of dogs. Beware of evil workers. Beware of the concision (those who only cut the body).
For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the spirit. We rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh (outward things).
I also might have confidence in the flesh (outward things). If anyone else thinks they have reason to trust in the flesh (outward things), I have more:
I was circumcised the 8th day. I am of the stock (family line) of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin. I am a Hebrew of the Hebrews. As touching the law, I was a Pharisee.
Concerning zeal, I persecuted (attacked for faith) the church. Touching the righteousness (being right with God) which is in the law, I was blameless.
But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.

Yes doubtless, I count all things but loss. This is for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord. For Christ I have suffered the loss of all things. I count them but dung (garbage), that I may win Christ.

I want to be found in Christ. I do not want my own righteousness (being right with God), which is of the law. I want that which is through the faith of Christ. It is the righteousness (being right with God) which is of God by faith.
I want to know Christ, and the power of His resurrection (rising from the dead). I want to know the fellowship (sharing) of His sufferings, being made conformable (made like Him) to His death.
I want this if by any means I might attain (reach) to the resurrection (rising) of the dead.
I have not already attained (reached it), nor am I already perfect (complete). But I follow after. I want to apprehend (take hold of) that for which Christ Jesus apprehended (took hold of) me.
Brothers, I do not count myself to have apprehended (taken hold of it). But this one thing I do. I forget those things which are behind. I reach forth to those things which are before.
I press toward the mark (goal) for the prize. It is the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
As many as are perfect (full-grown), let us therefore be thus minded (think this way). If in anything you are otherwise minded (think differently), God will reveal (show) even this to you.
Nevertheless, as far as we have already attained (reached), let us walk by the same rule. Let us mind (think) the same thing.
Brothers, be followers together of me. Mark (watch) those who walk so, as you have us for an ensample (example).
For many walk as the enemies of the cross of Christ. I have told you of them often. Now I tell you even weeping.
Their end is destruction. Their god is their belly (stomach). Their glory is in their shame. They mind (think about) earthly things.
For our conversation (citizenship) is in heaven. From there also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ.

Christ will change our vile (lowly) body, that it may be fashioned like to His glorious body. He will do this by the working of His power. By it He is able even to subdue (bring under) all things to Himself.
Therefore, my brothers dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown: So stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
I beseech (beg) Euodias, and I beseech (beg) Syntyche, to be of the same mind in the Lord.

And I intreat (ask) you also, true yokefellow (partner). Help those women who laboured (worked hard) with me in the gospel (good news). They laboured (worked hard) with Clement also, and with my other fellowlabourers (fellow workers). Their names are in the book of life.
Rejoice in the Lord always. And again I say: Rejoice.
Let your moderation (gentle self-control) be known to all people. The Lord is at hand (near).
Be careful (worried) for nothing. But in everything let your requests be made known to God. Do it by prayer and supplication (asking) with thanksgiving.
And the peace of God, which passes (goes beyond) all understanding, will keep your hearts and minds. It will keep them through Christ Jesus.

Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honest, whatever things are just (right): Whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: If there is any virtue (goodness), and if there is any praise, think on these things.
Do those things which you have learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me. And the God of peace will be with you.
But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly. Now at the last your care of me has flourished again. You were careful (caring) about me before, but you lacked opportunity.
I do not speak in respect of want (need). For I have learned to be content in whatever state I am.

I know both how to be abased (brought low), and how to abound (have plenty). Everywhere and in all things I am instructed (taught). I am taught both to be full and to be hungry. I am taught both to abound (have plenty) and to suffer need.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Notwithstanding (even so), you have done well. You did communicate with (share in) my affliction (trouble).
Now you Philippians know also about the beginning of the gospel (good news). When I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with (shared with) me in giving and receiving. Only you did.
For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my necessity (need).
I do not desire a gift. But I desire fruit that may abound (add up) to your account.

But I have all, and abound (have plenty). I am full, having received from Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you. They are an odour (smell) of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable and wellpleasing to God.
But my God will supply all your need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Now to God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
Salute (greet) every saint (holy person) in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.
All the saints (holy people) salute (greet) you, chiefly those who are of Caesar's household (family).
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
